title: Native direct evaluation satisfies the canonical derived unit equation
statement: For any sequence of commutative rings $R_n$ with adjacent transition maps $q_n:R_{n+1}\to R_n$, morphism of schemes $g:Z\to Y$, and index $n$, the specified native evaluation comparison $\mathrm{evalP}_{g,n}$ is unit-normalized relative to the ordinary comparison $\mathrm{moduleEvalP}_{g,n}$ and the specified evaluation localization factors [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. More precisely, on every cochain complex $I$ of native sequence modules, compose the unit of derived pushforward with evalP and then the image of the source evaluation localization factor: this equals the target evaluation localization factor followed by the localized map of moduleEvalP and the derived unit of level-n pushforward. This is the unitNormalized equation of [lem-pur-derived-square-normalization-naturality], with no cartesianness or finiteness condition on the sequence.

source.place: Tags 0D6E and 0D6J; Zheng Construction 4.1; derived adjunction unit normalization.

proof.text: The moduleEvalG comparison is normalized by the two ordinary adjunction units. The inverse-mate identity therefore identifies the mate of moduleEvalG.inv with moduleEvalP.hom. Apply localized_mate_cochain_normalization to moduleEvalG.symm on the given cochain complex. Precompose by the target evaluation localization factor and cancel the inverse factor. Identify the cochain unit with rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ through the quotient localization factors. Finally unfold the specified evalP mate and its adjunctions: its expression is exactly the localized inverse-mate square just obtained, proving the unitNormalized equation on every complex.

theorem compactSupportRawDirectNormalization
    (R : ℕ → CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (q : ∀ n, R (n + 1) ⟶ R n)
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    CategoryTheory.ExactDerivedSquare.unitNormalized.{u + 1, u + 2}
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.push R q g) (ProEtale.StrictTower.moduleDirectImage (R n) g)
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.eval R q Z n) (ProEtale.VaryingRing.eval R q Y n)
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.ev R q Z n) (ProEtale.VaryingRing.ev R q Y n)
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.eval R q Z n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.eval R q Y n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleEvalP R q g n).hom
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalP R q g n).hom
